A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same Wiki-R1 paper, with 19 readable pages including Appendices A-C. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison establish that the equations, algorithms, tables, figures and appendices are available for reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original Wiki-R1 evaluations on Encyclopedic VQA, InfoSeek and ViQuAE, component ablations, hyperparameter analyses and three-run training curves.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original benchmark results, ablations and appendix experiments, including the independent-run results in Appendix B and Figure 5.

M1.justification: The retrieval-controlled data curriculum, sampling curriculum, observation propagation and training objective are unchanged in Section 3 and Algorithms 1-2. The revised citation in Section 3.4 does not change the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use Encyclopedic VQA and InfoSeek for training and evaluation, ViQuAE for zero-shot transfer, and the same oracle-document scenarios. No dataset or task coverage changes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout the tables, including the zero-shot models, retrieval-augmented methods, ViQuAE reading-comprehension baselines, and SFT/DAPO ablations. Bibliographic edits do not add or remove evaluated methods.

E3.justification: The evaluation protocols, metrics, model sizes and training settings are identical. Both retain 20k training examples per main benchmark and separate 1k InfoSeek subsets for evaluation and hyperparameter selection.

E4.justification: Both retain the same component ablations, propagation-similarity comparison, training-dynamics analyses and hyperparameter sensitivity experiments in Section 4.5 and Appendix A. No analysis or case study is added or removed.

E5.justification: Appendix B reports three independent runs in both versions, with identical curves in Figure 5. Run information and statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical tables and plotted results are identical, including the appendix results. For example, Table 1 retains Wiki-R1 7B scores of 37.1 on EVQA and 44.1 on InfoSeek, and Table 2 retains 55.6 F1 and 50.3 exact match on ViQuAE.

T1.justification: Equations 1-6, the task formulation, optimization expressions and propagation mathematics are unchanged. Neither version adds a theorem, proof or mathematical correction relative to the other.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution statements and conclusion retain the same claims about curriculum reinforcement learning, state-of-the-art KB-VQA performance and generalization to unseen questions.

C2.justification: The explanations concerning sparse rewards, retrieval noise, observation propagation and training behavior are identical. Section 5 retains the limitation that retrieval manipulation only partially controls the distributional gap.

D1.justification: Implementation and reproducibility information is unchanged, including hyperparameters, retrieval-score fusion, graph construction, hardware, training times and the project-page address. Appendices A-C contain no revised disclosures.

R1.justification: The distinct cited works and research positioning are unchanged. NoisyGRPO receives publication metadata, while two identical Shi et al. entries are consolidated; these are bibliographic edits rather than additions or removals of prior work.

P1.justification: v2 updates NoisyGRPO from an arXiv reference to a proceedings reference, adjusts the Qiu citation suffixes, and merges Shi et al. 2025a/2025b into 2025. The arXiv version/date stamp also changes; substantive prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Citation edits cause small local changes in line wrapping, and the revised bibliography changes spacing on page 13. All five figures, eight tables, their captions and placements, and the appendix layouts remain identical.

improvement.justification: v2 removes a duplicate Shi et al. reference and unifies its citation labels, improving bibliographic consistency. The NoisyGRPO entry also gains publication details. These provide a small editorial improvement; the scientific content, supporting evidence and reproducibility information are unchanged.
